svg.title: Base Case: $487,500 Revenue to $219,375 Owner Profit
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-03-base-case-owner-profit; chart type: waterfall; title: Base Case: $487,500 Revenue to $219,375 Owner Profit; subtitle: Six bars reconcile the canonical 45.0% annual net margin; chapter number: 3; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Formula v2.0 scenario totals are fixed; expense categories below are an illustrative reconciliation rather than supplied historical accounts. Base revenue is entirely earned B2B service fees, with $0 contingent awards. Positive endpoints are totals; the four negative bars are expense movements. Do not add the final total to the preceding movements.; caption: Conservative: $95,000 revenue less $64,600 costs equals $30,400 owner profit at 32%, with 1 FT + 2 C. Base: $487,500 less $268,125 equals $219,375 at 45.0%, with 1 FT + 2 C. Scaled: $880,000 less $369,600 equals $510,400 at 58%, with 2 FT + 3 C. All three scenarios can be modeled with zero award receipts. Government recoveries, sanctions, tax proceeds, and client funds are not operator revenue.; stages: label: Recognized Service Revenue; value: $487,500 annual earned operator service revenue; numeric value: 487500.0; detail: Five annual engagements supply the opening total. Recognize services as earned and track cash collection separately. Exclude agency recoveries and uncollected claims; recognize only the operator's eligible retained portion of any separately realized award.; label: Delivery Labor; value: Subtract $165,000 annual delivery labor expense; numeric value: -165000.0; detail: Illustrative allocation covers contracted analytical delivery and non-owner delivery support. Residual owner profit is owner compensation, not an additional salary deduction; remaining contribution is $322,500.; label: Evidence Infrastructure; value: Subtract $36,000 annual data and tooling expense; numeric value: -36000.0; detail: Budget licensed datasets, secure matter storage, reproducible processing, backup retention, and source retrieval. Record subscription rights by project; remaining contribution is $286,500.; label: Specialist Matter Support; value: Subtract $42,000 annual specialist support expense; numeric value: -42000.0; detail: Budget business-side specialist consultation and external technical validation. Do not imply that this purchases representation for every relator; remaining contribution is $244,500.; label: Operating Overhead; value: Subtract $25,125 annual operating overhead expense; numeric value: -25125.0; detail: Allocate insurance, bookkeeping, secure communications, business development, and administration. Total deductions reach $268,125, leaving $219,375.; label: Annual Owner Profit; value: $219,375 residual; exactly 45.0% net margin; numeric value: 219375.0; detail: Closing total equals $487,500 minus $268,125. Non-delivery operating categories total $103,125 annually, or $8,593.75 monthly, within the stated $1,500–$9,500 operating range; total costs including delivery labor average $22,343.75 monthly.

circle.title: label: Recognized Service Revenue; value: $487,500 annual earned operator service revenue; numeric value: 487500.0; detail: Five annual engagements supply the opening total. Recognize services as earned and track cash collection separately. Exclude agency recoveries and uncollected claims; recognize only the operator's eligible retained portion of any separately realized award.

label: Delivery Labor; value: Subtract $165,000 annual delivery labor expense; numeric value: -165000.0; detail: Illustrative allocation covers contracted analytical delivery and non-owner delivery support. Residual owner profit is owner compensation, not an additional salary deduction; remaining contribution is $322,500.

label: Evidence Infrastructure; value: Subtract $36,000 annual data and tooling expense; numeric value: -36000.0; detail: Budget licensed datasets, secure matter storage, reproducible processing, backup retention, and source retrieval. Record subscription rights by project; remaining contribution is $286,500.

label: Specialist Matter Support; value: Subtract $42,000 annual specialist support expense; numeric value: -42000.0; detail: Budget business-side specialist consultation and external technical validation. Do not imply that this purchases representation for every relator; remaining contribution is $244,500.

label: Operating Overhead; value: Subtract $25,125 annual operating overhead expense; numeric value: -25125.0; detail: Allocate insurance, bookkeeping, secure communications, business development, and administration. Total deductions reach $268,125, leaving $219,375.

label: Annual Owner Profit; value: $219,375 residual; exactly 45.0% net margin; numeric value: 219375.0; detail: Closing total equals $487,500 minus $268,125. Non-delivery operating categories total $103,125 annually, or $8,593.75 monthly, within the stated $1,500–$9,500 operating range; total costs including delivery labor average $22,343.75 monthly.
